No revenue published; last funding round 2021 (user sheet). Scale signals from nydig.com: 3+ GW power and compute pipeline, 1+ GW deliverable in 2027 and 2028, affiliate Stone Ridge Energy produces about 3% of US natural gas. A sponsorship decision may sit with Stone Ridge.

Business change: the user sheet describes bitcoin custody, trading and bank enablement. nydig.com now presents NYDIG as a developer and operator of power and compute for AI, high-performance computing and bitcoin mining. The licensed entities NYDIG Trust Company and NYDIG Execution (One Vanderbilt Avenue, New York) are still listed on the licenses page, but the site no longer markets services to banks and fintechs. Email written to the AI infrastructure business; banks and fintechs left out of the target sentence.
Target audience: nydig.com names no customers, only HPC clients needing several hundred MW and 'investment-grade counterparties'. Grid names are sector examples, not NYDIG customers.
Market overlap: site says 'multi-site North American portfolio' without naming states or countries; only US races listed.
HQ: nydig.com gives no head office; One Vanderbilt Avenue, New York is the address of its licensed entities.
Grid: Core Scientific is Cadillac's Official Data Center Partner (10 Mar 2026, multi-year); CoreWeave is Aston Martin's Official AI Cloud Computing Partner.
No Formula 1 deal found for NYDIG. Compliance: private, not state-owned; no sanctions, Entity List or Chapter 11 issue seen (not screened against official lists).
Contacts: none found in Apollo.
